security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU's CSR read/write handlers for sip/sie, vsip/vsie, hip/hie, hvip, hedeleg, hideleg, hgeie, stvec/vstvec, mnepc, mncause, or mnstatus do not apply per-bit WARL masking on writes (silently dropping writes to read-only-zero bits) and do not apply WARL legalization on reads (returning only the constrained legal value). A guest write to an unimplemented interrupt bit in sie that persists on read-back, or a write to a read-only-zero delegation bit in hedeleg/hideleg that is not silently ignored, violates the spec's WARL contract.
security_spec.summary: Missing or incomplete WARL bit-masking in QEMU's hypervisor, supervisor, and RNMI CSR emulation allows guest reads to observe unwritable bits that the spec mandates as read-only zero, leaking implementation details about which interrupt types and delegation paths are supported

findings.finding: mnepc write accepts raw val without any WARL masking. mepc uses get_xepc_mask() to enforce alignment (bit 0 clear) and bit XLEN-1 constraint, but mnepc applies no legalization at all. A guest can write arbitrary unaligned addresses to mnepc, violating the WARL contract.

mncause write accepts raw val without WARL masking. The header comment in cpu.h says 'mncause without bit XLEN-1 set to 1' (line 506) implying bit XLEN-1 should be read-only zero, but the write handler does not enforce this constraint. A guest write setting bit XLEN-1 would persist, violating the WARL contract.

RNMI CSRs (mnepc, mncause, mnstatus) are not included in any vmstate subsection. No vmstate_rnmi subsection exists in the entire codebase. The subsection list includes pmp, hyper, vector, pointermasking, rv128, kvmtimer, envcfg, debug, smstateen, jvt, elp, ssp but NOT rnmi. On live migration, mnepc/mncause/mnstatus values will silently reset to zero on the destination, causing corrupted RNMI state.

mnepc read returns raw env->mnepc without WARL legalization. mepc does '*val = env->mepc & get_xepc_mask(env)' to return only legal bits, but mnepc returns the raw stored value without masking. If a bug elsewhere stores an illegal value, it will be exposed on read.

mncause read returns raw env->mncause without WARL legalization. The cpu.h comment states bit XLEN-1 should not be set to 1, but the read path does not enforce this constraint, meaning an illegal stored value will be exposed on read.

mnstatus write correctly applies WARL masking using a mask of MNSTATUS_NMIE | MNSTATUS_MNPP (plus MNSTATUS_MNPV when RVH is present). MNSTATUS_NMIE is preserved from the old value (hardware-only clear, WLRL behavior). Reserved bits are correctly write-ignored and read-as-zero.

sie read/write correctly applies complex WARL masking via alias_mask (bits delegated via mideleg) and nalias_mask (non-delegated bits visible through mvien). Bits where both mideleg=0 and mvien=0 are read-only zero. In virt mode, properly delegates to rmw_vsie64. WARL contract is fully enforced.

sip correctly applies WARL masking. Write mask constrains writable bits to (mideleg | mvien) & sip_writable_mask (SIP_SSIP | LOCAL_INTERRUPTS). Read return value is masked to (mideleg | mvien) & (S_MODE_INTERRUPTS | LOCAL_INTERRUPTS). Bits where both delegation and mvien are 0 are correctly read-only zero.

vsie correctly applies alias (delegated via hideleg) and non-alias (hvien without hideleg) WARL masking with proper VS-mode bit position remapping. Bits in neither mask are read-only zero. WARL contract fully enforced.

vsip correctly applies WARL masking through hideleg/hvien-based alias/nalias masks, filtered by vsip_writable_mask (MIP_VSSIP | LOCAL_INTERRUPTS). VS* bits not delegated via hideleg are zeroed out. Read return value is properly split between alias bits from mip and non-alias bits from hvip.
hip correctly constrains writes via hip_writable_mask (MIP_VSSIP only). Read value is masked to HS_MODE_INTERRUPTS. WARL contract enforced.
hie correctly constrains writes and reads to HS_MODE_INTERRUPTS (SGEIP | VSSIP | VSTIP | VSEIP). WARL contract fully enforced.

hedeleg correctly masks writes to vs_delegable_excps (all DELEGABLE_EXCPS minus S_ECALL, VS_ECALL, M_ECALL, and guest-page-fault/virtual-instruction exceptions). Non-delegable exception bits are silently dropped on write. WARL contract enforced.
hideleg correctly masks writes to vs_delegable_ints (VS_MODE_INTERRUPTS | LOCAL_INTERRUPTS, minus MIP_LCOFIP). Read value is also masked. WARL contract enforced.
hgeie correctly masks writes to GEILEN:1 implemented bits (BIT0 never implemented). Has proper side-effect of updating mip.SGEIP. WARL contract enforced.
stvec correctly WARL-constrains mode field bits [1:0]: 0=direct and 1=vectored are accepted, reserved modes >=2 are silently ignored. BASE field has 4-byte alignment. WARL contract enforced.
vstvec correctly WARL-constrains mode field identically to stvec. Reserved modes are silently ignored. WARL contract enforced.

hvip correctly applies alias/nalias WARL masking through hideleg/hvien, filtered by hvip_writable_mask. Has proper side-effect of calling riscv_cpu_interrupt() on hvip change. WARL contract fully enforced.

wr_mask_hvip = wr_mask & nalias_mask & hvip_writable_mask;
wr_mask_mip = wr_mask & alias_mask & hvip_writable_mask;
